radio.instruction: Tune the radio to BBC Radio 2.
radio.title: BBC Radio 2

climate.instruction: Set the driver cabin temperature to 21 degrees Celsius. Keep the passenger temperature unchanged.
climate.title: Driver temperature

trunk.title: Open trunk
trunk.instruction: Open the trunk. Leave all doors closed.

driver-door.title: Open driver door
driver-door.instruction: Open the driver door. Leave the other doors and trunk unchanged.

passenger-door.title: Open passenger door
passenger-door.instruction: Open the passenger door. Leave the other doors and trunk unchanged.

close-all.title: Close all body parts
close-all.instruction: Close all open body parts, including the hood, trunk, charging port and every door.
close-all.verificationNote: The reset fixture opens every live InterestPoint, including parts without a CarData field. Success waits for every local part animation to finish closed.

driving.title: Driving simulation
driving.instruction: Open the driving assistance view and let the driving simulation run.

gear-drive.title: Select Drive
gear-drive.instruction: Select Drive (D) on the visible gear selector.
gear-drive.verificationNote: Verifies actual selected gear UI state and scene. The template does not write CarData.CurrentGear or simulate selected-gear vehicle physics; Reverse does not prove physical reversing.

gear-neutral.title: Select Neutral
gear-neutral.instruction: Select Neutral (N) on the visible gear selector.
gear-neutral.verificationNote: Verifies actual selected gear UI state and scene. The template does not write CarData.CurrentGear or simulate selected-gear vehicle physics; Reverse does not prove physical reversing.

gear-reverse.title: Select Reverse
gear-reverse.instruction: Select Reverse (R) on the visible gear selector.
gear-reverse.verificationNote: Verifies actual selected gear UI state and scene. The template does not write CarData.CurrentGear or simulate selected-gear vehicle physics; Reverse does not prove physical reversing.

fan.title: Fan level 6
fan.instruction: Set the cabin fan level to 6. Keep both temperature settings unchanged.

driver-seat.title: Driver seat heating
driver-seat.instruction: Set driver seat heating to level 1, leaving passenger seat heating off.

passenger-seat.title: Passenger seat heating
passenger-seat.instruction: Set passenger seat heating to level 1, leaving driver seat heating off.

theme.title: Second color theme
theme.instruction: Select the second color theme in the visible color selector.

music-next.title: Next music track
music-next.instruction: Advance the music player to the next track, keeping playback paused.
music-next.expected: If You Say Pi, I Say Po
music-next.verificationNote: Playback starts paused so automatic track progression cannot satisfy this task.

hood.title: Open hood
hood.instruction: Open hood. Leave the other body parts closed.
hood.verificationNote: Verifies the actual local InterestPoint open state after its animation has settled.
hood.availabilityNote: The loaded Industry HMI Template instantiates only trunk and two front-door InterestPoint controls. This enum-only part has no interactive control in the sample scene.

charging-port.title: Open charging port
charging-port.instruction: Open charging port. Leave the other body parts closed.
charging-port.verificationNote: Verifies the actual local InterestPoint open state after its animation has settled.
charging-port.availabilityNote: The loaded Industry HMI Template instantiates only trunk and two front-door InterestPoint controls. This enum-only part has no interactive control in the sample scene.

rear-left-door.title: Open rear left door
rear-left-door.instruction: Open rear left door. Leave the other body parts closed.
rear-left-door.verificationNote: Verifies the actual local InterestPoint open state after its animation has settled.
rear-left-door.availabilityNote: The loaded Industry HMI Template instantiates only trunk and two front-door InterestPoint controls. This enum-only part has no interactive control in the sample scene.

rear-right-door.title: Open rear right door
rear-right-door.instruction: Open rear right door. Leave the other body parts closed.
rear-right-door.verificationNote: Verifies the actual local InterestPoint open state after its animation has settled.
rear-right-door.availabilityNote: The loaded Industry HMI Template instantiates only trunk and two front-door InterestPoint controls. This enum-only part has no interactive control in the sample scene.

gear-parking.title: Select Parking
gear-parking.instruction: Select Parking (P) on the visible gear selector.
gear-parking.verificationNote: Verifies selected gear UI and resulting scene only; no claim about vehicle physics, reversing or physical parking.
